title: A Meaningful Interaction-A Shared Vision-A Brighter Future
description:
A Meaningful Interaction-A Shared Vision-A Brighter Future

At Perhit Siksha Foundation, every interaction is an opportunity to reaffirm our collective commitment towards nurturing young minds and empowering children through quality education. We were privileged to host an inspiring and heartfelt interaction in Lucknow, led by Sh. Sanjay Rathi Sir, who spent valuable time engaging with our dedicated mentors and the parents of our beneficiary students.

The session commenced with Sh. Rathi Sir taking everyone through the inspiring journey of the Foundation. He fondly recalled how this noble initiative began during the challenging days of the COVID-19 pandemic with the COVID Kitchen, which served thousands of meals to the attendants of hospitalized patients. What started as a humanitarian response to an unprecedented crisis gradually evolved into CGST Lucknow Social Initiatives (CLSI), focusing on transforming lives through education. Today, that vision has expanded into its new and more comprehensive identity-Perhit Siksha Foundation-dedicated to ensuring that every deserving child receives the opportunity to dream, learn, and succeed. 

He also highlighted the Foundation's growing outreach through its active presence on Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, which continues to inspire countless individuals to become a part of this mission.

The meeting began with a warm introduction of the parents, creating an atmosphere of familiarity and belonging. As each parent shared their background and aspirations for their children, the gathering quickly transformed into a family-like interaction built on trust, empathy, and shared purpose.

An open and engaging discussion followed, during which parents candidly shared the challenges they face in providing quality education to their children. Their experiences, concerns, and suggestions offered valuable insights into the realities on the ground and further strengthened the Foundation's resolve to stand beside every beneficiary family in their educational journey.

Patiently listening to every concern, Sh. Rathi Sir assured the parents that the Foundation remains committed to supporting deserving students in every possible manner. He encouraged them to maintain regular communication with their respective mentors and the Foundation whenever they require guidance or assistance. 

Stressing that education is the most valuable investment in a child's future, he urged parents to continuously motivate their children to perform well academically while simultaneously cultivating discipline, integrity, compassion, and strong moral values.

He further informed the parents that if any academically promising student requires additional support—whether towards tuition fees, educational resources, or other genuine academic needs-the matter should be promptly brought to the notice of the Foundation so that timely assistance can be considered. He reiterated that no talented child should ever be deprived of opportunities due to financial constraints.

In a thoughtful gesture aimed at strengthening the unique bond between contributors and beneficiaries, Sh. Sanjay Rathi Sir also encouraged parents to send simple greeting messages to their respective contributors on national occasions such as Independence Day and Republic Day, as well as on other special occasions. Such heartfelt expressions of gratitude, he said, go a long way in nurturing lasting relationships built on mutual respect and encouragement.

A detailed interaction was also held with the mentors, who shared the academic progress of their mentees, the challenges encountered during mentoring, and several constructive suggestions for making the mentorship programme even more impactful. Discussions focused on improving regular academic monitoring, strengthening emotional support, and identifying deserving students who may require additional financial or educational assistance.

The meeting proved to be a valuable platform for meaningful dialogue, collaborative problem-solving, and renewed commitment from every stakeholder. It beautifully reinforced the idea that the success of every child rests upon the combined efforts of the Foundation, contributors, mentors, parents, and the students themselves.

The enriching session concluded on a cheerful note over delicious refreshments, where conversations continued in a relaxed and informal atmosphere. These moments of togetherness further strengthened the bond that makes Perhit Siksha Foundation much more than an organization—it is a compassionate family united by the shared mission of transforming lives through education.

Together, we continue to move forward with one unwavering belief:
Every child deserves an opportunity to dream, learn, grow, and succeed.

title: Huma Qureshi lends her voice to the cause of education - spreading hope, opportunity, and the pow...
description:
Huma Qureshi lends her voice to the cause of education - spreading hope, opportunity, and the power of learning.

From delivering powerful performances in acclaimed films such as Gangs of Wasseypur, Badlapur, Jolly LLB 2, Maharani, and Tarla to earning admiration for her versatility and authenticity, Huma Qureshi ji has consistently inspired audiences through her remarkable body of work. Today, she extends her wholehearted support to a cause that has the power to transform generations – education for underprivileged children.

In her inspiring message, Huma Qureshi ji highlights the importance of ensuring that every child, irrespective of their background or circumstances, has access to quality education and the opportunity to build a brighter future. She believes that education is not merely a means of learning, but a pathway to confidence, dignity, and empowerment.

What particularly resonates with her is the Foundation’s commitment to transparency and accountability. She appreciates that every contribution made towards a child's education is transferred directly to the beneficiary's account, ensuring that support reaches the child without any intermediaries and creates a meaningful impact where it is needed the most.

Her encouragement and support provide immense motivation to the mission of Perhit Siksha Foundation – a collective effort dedicated to nurturing dreams, unlocking potential, and creating opportunities for children who deserve a chance to succeed.

We express our heartfelt gratitude to Huma Qureshi ji for standing with Perhit Siksha Foundation and inspiring society to participate in this noble mission.

Together, let us educate, empower, and uplift young minds—because every educated child is a step towards a stronger, more compassionate, and more prosperous future.

title: A Story of Dreams, Determination & the Power of Giving Back
description:
A Story of Dreams, Determination & the Power of Giving Back

When our contributor Mr. Amit Rajoria, currently serving with the Central GST Department in Udaipur, visited Haridwar to meet Anshi - a Class 8 student supported through Perhit Shiksha - what unfolded was a truly heartwarming exchange.

Anshi comes from a humble background; her father works as a rickshaw driver. When Mr. Rajoria arrived at her school, classes had already ended for the day — but Anshi was specially called from her nearby home, making the meeting all the more special.

Mr. Rajoria shared his own journey with her: studying in a village government school where lessons were often held under a tree due to lack of infrastructure. Yet through grit and perseverance, he went on to clear one of India's toughest competitive exams and join government service.

His message to Anshi, who dreams of becoming a doctor: keep working hard - your circumstances don't define your future.

He gifted her a box of chocolates and his warmest wishes.

The school authorities were so moved by the interaction that they've invited Mr. Rajoria to return and address more students in the future.

This is what Perhit Shiksha is all about - not just financial support, but mentorship, encouragement, and belief in a child's potential.

🙏 Thank you, Mr. Rajoria, for taking the time to inspire the next generation.
